thread:
Aisha Khan: Heads up 1: interviewer training bundles not assigned for several new hires — training system expects role_slug but webhook sent role_title. Noticed 29 affected accounts.
Maya Rodriguez: Saw a few interviewers without the 'interviewer_basics' badge this morning. That explains the missing prep links.
Samir Patel: Quick check: webhook payload has "role_title":"Backend Engineer" vs our expected "role_slug":"backend_engineer". Router fails silently and assigns generic bundle.
Noah Park: Can we backfill? We should also pause auto-assignment to avoid more wrong bundles overnight.
Aisha Khan: Pause in progress. Noah - confirm when paused.
Noah Park: Paused auto-assign jobs and took a snapshot.
Samir Patel: I'll add a normalizer that maps role_title->role_slug (lowercase, spaces->underscore) and a small mapping table for exceptions. Will also add a CI test feeding sample vendor payloads.
Recruiting Bot: :warning: 29 accounts matched query for missing badges.
Maya Rodriguez: Drafting comms: "Hi — we updated your training assignment to include interviewer prep. No action needed unless you'd like different materials." Sending after legal review.
Aisha Khan: Plan: 1) deploy normalizer + tests; 2) run idempotent backfill to assign proper bundles; 3) re-run badge sync for impacted accounts; 4) update vendor onboarding checklist to include sample payload.
Samir Patel: Patch ready, running staging dry-run. Backfill report will list changed accounts.
Noah Park: After dry-run, we'll push to prod and re-sync badges.
Maya Rodriguez: Adding incident note for monthly recruiting ops review.
Aisha Khan: Assignments: Samir - normalizer + backfill + tests; Noah - pause/verify + deploy; Maya - comms + legal. Will update thread when prod is green. :thumbsup:
